bottom_line: Iranian seizure of a commercial tanker in the Strait of Hormuz escalates maritime risk, raising war-risk premiums and oil supply disruption probability.
what_changed: IRGC Navy seized a commercial tanker transiting the Strait of Hormuz; vessel flagged to a non-Iranian state; crew detained.
why_it_matters: Hormuz handles ~20% of global oil trade; tanker seizure signals willingness to escalate, affecting insurance costs and routing decisions.
main_uncertainty: Whether seizure is isolated incident or start of a pattern; diplomatic resolution timeline unknown.

scenarios.name: Diplomatic resolution
scenarios.description: Vessel and crew released after negotiations; incident treated as isolated.

scenarios.name: Pattern escalation
scenarios.description: Additional seizures or threats; Hormuz risk premium becomes structural.
